Micron Technology customer concentration risk disclosure 10-K "10%" customer
Micron largest customer 2026 credit rating downgrade OR bankruptcy OR guidance cut
Micron top customer name undisclosed 17% revenue CMBU segment 2026

findings.claim: One undisclosed customer (primarily in the CMBU cloud memory segment) accounted for 17% of Micron's total revenue in fiscal Q1 2026 (quarter ended late Nov 2025).
Revenue from that same undisclosed customer (CMBU segment) fell to 13% of total revenue for the first six months of fiscal 2026, versus 15% in the same period of fiscal 2025.

Revenue from that customer further declined to 10% of total revenue for the first nine months of fiscal 2026, versus 16% in the same period of fiscal 2025 — concentration trending down over the fiscal year.
Micron's top ten customers together accounted for roughly half of total fiscal 2025 revenue.
findings.source: Micron FY2025 Form 10-K annual report summary, https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/MU/10-k-micron-technology-inc-files-annual-report-a879767daea7.html

note: SEC filings do not disclose the identity of Micron's top (~10-17%) customer — only that it sits primarily in the CMBU segment. Because the customer's name is confidential, its own credit rating / balance-sheet health could not be independently verified via search; no bankruptcy, downgrade, or guidance-cut news tied to any named Micron customer was found.
